name: io.github.anonyme-afk/universal-device-mcp
title: Universal Device MCP
description: Local-first MCP server for safe discovery, inspection, and controlled communication with connected hardware.

environmentVariables.name: UDMCP_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local default-deny hardware access policy.

environmentVariables.description: Path to the local SQLite device database.

environmentVariables.name: UDMCP_ENABLE_SIMULATOR
environmentVariables.description: Enable built-in simulated devices; defaults to false.
